description: Returns indicative monthly prices for mortgage protection or level term life cover from every insurer on the mylife.ie panel, for a person living in Ireland, cheapest first. Takes the product, the amount, the term and, for each person, a date of birth (or an age if the date is not known) and whether they smoke. Each quote includes the disclosures that go with the prices and a shortUrl where the person can see the quote and apply on mylife.ie.

convertible.description: Quote with the conversion option. Default false.

cover.description: single: one person. joint: two people, pays once on the first death. dual: two people, each covered, can pay twice. Defaults to single for one person.

indexation.description: life_term only: cover rises each year. Not accepted for mortgage_protection.

lives.description: One person for single cover, two for joint or dual.

age.description: Age in whole years, only if the date of birth is not known. The price is then an estimate.

anyOf.description: Date of birth as day, month and year numbers.

dob.description: Date of birth. Preferred over age.

smoker.description: Whether the person has smoked or used nicotine in the last 12 months.

product.description: mortgage_protection: cover that falls over the term to match a repayment mortgage. life_term: level term life cover, a fixed amount for the whole term.

sumAssured.description: Amount of cover in euro, 10,000 to 10,000,000. For mortgage protection, the amount owed.

termYears.description: Length of cover in years, 5 to 40. For mortgage protection, the years left on the mortgage.

name: get_quote
title: Get prices
